QuestInfo.name: There Goes the Gang
QuestInfo.0: You should go after Velderoth. Talk to Kyle.
QuestInfo.1: Velderoth left Pantheon. You have a lot on your mind. Talk to Eskalade.
QuestInfo.2: Velderoth left Pantheon. You have a lot on your mind, but you have to believe that he will return someday. Do what you can until then to show how much more powerful you have become.
